chunks: Fudayl ibn Yasar narrated from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he said:

"Indeed, the houses in which prayer is performed with the recitation of the Quran illuminate for the inhabitants of the heaven, just as the stars of the sky illuminate for the inhabitants of the earth."
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward of reciting the Quran in one's home?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) via Fudayl ibn Yasar, emphasizing the metaphysical impact of domestic Quranic recitation. The hadith employs a celestial analogy to illustrate how the spiritual light (*nur*) generated by prayer in the home illuminates the heavenly realms, reinforcing the concept of the home as a microcosm of worship that bridges the earthly and divine spheres.
